title: 连接 EveryInfra
description: 填写你的 EveryInfra API Key。Key 只保存在本机，连接时作为请求头发送给 api.everyinfra.com，用于调用和计费。
description_en: Enter your EveryInfra API key. It is stored on this device only and sent to api.everyinfra.com as a request header for calls and billing.
docLabel_en: How do I create an API key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 以 ei_ 开头，在 everyinfra.com 控制台的 API Key 页面创建
fields.placeholder_en: Starts with ei_; create one on the API Keys page at everyinfra.com
fields.description: 注册 everyinfra.com 后在控制台创建；充值后即可调用付费能力。
fields.description_en: Sign up at everyinfra.com and create a key in the console; paid capabilities need a funded balance.
